prompt: Dennis's little dog swims just (bravely) that big golden dog in the waves!
explanation_ru: Конструкция just as + наречие + as показывает, что два действия равны по степени.

prompt: I smiled because both new helpers plant roses at (same / speed) each other.
explanation_ru: Для сравнения одинаковых признаков используется устойчивая связка the same + существительное + as, а не like или than.

prompt: Our bridge lamps aren't (bright) the station lights, so winter walkers trip.
explanation_ru: В отрицательном предложении неравенство передаётся через not as/so + прилагательное + as.

prompt: Why doesn't our toaster brown both sides (well) a normal one?
explanation_ru: Для сравнения того, как выполняется действие, после глагола используется наречие в конструкции as well as.

prompt: The clinic bell isn't (loud) the fans in your busy waiting room.
explanation_ru: Чтобы сказать, что один предмет уступает другому, после отрицания ставим as/so + прилагательное + as.

prompt: Thin cable locks are not (strong) steel bars, so bike thieves cut them in seconds at this shed.
explanation_ru: В отрицательном сравнении используется схема not as/so + прилагательное + as, сохраняющая исходную форму прилагательного.

prompt: I can't believe this free bus app tracks arriving buses just (accurately) the paid version!
explanation_ru: С наречием accurately равенство точности работы двух приложений выражается конструкцией just as accurately as.

prompt: At the harbour fair, my lemon cake tasted just (light) Ngaire's, and its golden sponge looked (similar) hers.
explanation_ru: Равенство передаётся через just as light as, а прилагательное similar всегда требует предлога to.

prompt:
— Did you use a plum-cake recipe (different) mine?
— Completely, yet the crispy edge came out (same) yours!
explanation_ru: После different в британском английском используется предлог from (или to), а с same обязательны артикль the и союз as.

prompt: Latoya sent me a photo of two museum benches whose curved wooden legs look (similar) a framed artwork upstairs.
explanation_ru: Прилагательное similar употребляется с предлогом to (а не with или as), когда предметы похожи друг на друга.

prompt: Femi laughed when Segun walked in wearing an identical blue shirt, because Segun's tailor had charged twice (much) his local shop and still hadn't finished half (quickly) Femi's.
explanation_ru: Кратное сравнение строится через twice/half + as + наречие/much + as, без сравнительной степени и союза than.

prompt: Dries told Hanne that the first seaside hotel offers twice (many / bikes) the place next door, yet its rooms don't cost half (much) the big hotel down the lane.
explanation_ru: С исчисляемым существительным bikes используется twice as many bikes as, а с глаголом cost — half as much as.

prompt: Cody grinned when the cheap blues record played just (cleanly) the boxed set, even though the shop edition was three times (expensive) his bargain copy.
explanation_ru: Для сравнения качества звучания берём наречие as cleanly as, а кратность цены передаём через three times as expensive as.

prompt: Please wash your mugs after lunch in our office kitchen. There are never (many / spoons) we need at midday. Clean cups also don't last (long) they should.
explanation_ru: С исчисляемым существительным spoons в отрицании ставим as many spoons as, а длительность действия передаём через as long as.

prompt: We stayed at this beach hotel in Marmaris. The coffee machine jammed daily, so breakfast wasn't (calm) the sunny photos online. In fact, the crowded hall felt completely (different) the quiet terrace in the brochure. To make things worse, the tiny milk jug emptied twice (fast) the staff could fill it.
explanation_ru: В тексте сочетаются три модели: отрицательное сравнение not as/so calm as, предлог after different (from/to) и кратность скорости twice as fast as.

prompt: Colm, our new tumble dryer is driving me mad! Does yours shake (hard) ours does? This machine isn't (quiet) the old one we threw out, and it actually runs twice (noisily) our garden mower.
explanation_ru: Вопросительное равенство и кратность действия строятся с наречиями (as hard as, twice as noisily as), а отрицательное качество — через isn't as/so quiet as.

prompt: I stopped at this hill top cafe hoping for a cosy break. Sadly, my pot didn't arrive (hot) I expected. The toasted buns felt almost (tough) cardboard. Worse still, we waited twice (long) the people at the next table for our bill.
explanation_ru: Здесь противопоставлены отрицательное сравнение (didn't arrive as/so hot as), образное равенство (as tough as) и кратность времени ожидания (twice as long as).

prompt:
— Excuse me, why are you measuring my tiny backpack at the gate?
— Every bag has to fit the metal frame, sir.
— That rolling suitcase ahead of me is three times (big) mine, yet your colleague waved it through! My bag isn't half (heavy) that trunk, and it slides under the seat just (easily) a small handbag.
explanation_ru: После three times и half ставится базовая форма между as ... as (three times as big as, half as heavy as), а способ действия передаётся наречием just as easily as.

prompt: Ramiro wrote to the town planners after another noisy Saturday by the old stone gate. The medieval wall is nowhere near (solid) modern concrete, and heavy tour buses shake the arch when they pass. Local delivery vans don't rumble half (loudly) those coaches, nor do they stop (often) the sightseeing groups do. Unless the route changes, the stonework will crack.
explanation_ru: Усилитель nowhere near требует конструкции as solid as; в следующем предложении используются наречия с half as loudly as и отрицательное as/so often as.

prompt: Mallory reviewed the winter spy film for the college film letter yesterday. Although the studio spent twice the budget, the plot isn't nearly (clever) the first film's story. The car chases play out almost (predictably) a daytime TV show, and the new villain doesn't act half (convincingly) the original actor. Save your ticket money for something fresher.
explanation_ru: После isn't nearly идёт as/so clever as, а глаголы play out и act требуют наречий в моделях almost as predictably as и half as convincingly as.

prompt: Logan packed Mason's green bottle because it had ___ his own.
explanation_ru: Правильная связка — the same ... as. Русскоговорящие часто ошибочно подставляют like или than по аналогии с русским «такой же, как».

prompt: In science class, Pranav's cup of vinegar looked ___ Kavya's water.
explanation_ru: В утвердительном предложении равенство выражается только через as ... as; вариант so ... as допустим лишь в отрицании, а than и that здесь неверны.

prompt: I just noticed that the chemist across the street sells cut plasters at ___ the clinic shop.
explanation_ru: После the same всегда следует союз as. Типичная ошибка — ставить like, with или than.

prompt: Our hill steps stay icy for days because the salt trucks don't visit us ___ the main road.
explanation_ru: Парным элементом к первому as всегда является второе as. Использование than, like или that после as — частая ошибка.

prompt: Moritz texted me from the library because the drills outside now sound ___ the builders promised in their notice.
explanation_ru: При указании кратности («вдвое громче») в английском используется модель twice as + прилагательное + as, а не калька twice louder than.

prompt: The yellow noodle soup at that stall tastes the same like ours.
answer: The yellow noodle soup at that stall tastes the same as ours.
accepted_answers: The yellow noodle soup at that stall tastes the same as ours.
explanation_ru: После the same нужно ставить as, а не like — это типичная калька с русского «такой же, как».

prompt: After Saturday matches, our changing-room showers aren't as warm than the ones at the swimming pool.
answer: After Saturday matches, our changing-room showers aren't as warm as the ones at the swimming pool.
accepted_answers: After Saturday matches, our changing-room showers aren't as warm as the ones at the swimming pool.
After Saturday matches, our changing-room showers are not as warm as the ones at the swimming pool.
After Saturday matches, our changing-room showers aren't so warm as the ones at the swimming pool.
After Saturday matches, our changing-room showers are not so warm as the ones at the swimming pool.
explanation_ru: В конструкции not as ... as нельзя заменять второе as на than; союз than используется только со сравнительной степенью.

prompt: Khaled showed the class that modern clay bread moulds have almost the same shape as the ancient ones inside.
answer: Khaled showed the class that modern clay bread moulds have almost the same shape as the ancient ones inside.
accepted_answers: Khaled showed the class that modern clay bread moulds have almost the same shape as the ancient ones inside.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: конструкция almost the same shape as употреблена правильно — с артиклем the и союзом as.

prompt: Graeme complained to the island co-op that the new metal sheep gates bend twice faster than we can repair them in the salty sea wind.
answer: Graeme complained to the island co-op that the new metal sheep gates bend twice as fast as we can repair them in the salty sea wind.
accepted_answers: Graeme complained to the island co-op that the new metal sheep gates bend twice as fast as we can repair them in the salty sea wind.
explanation_ru: Слово twice в стандартном сравнении требует модели twice as fast as, а не сравнительной степени с than.

prompt: Henning shows students two sky lenses. Both lenses have an identical smooth curve.
options: The two sky lenses are completely different from each other.
One sky lens is twice as curved as the other.
The first sky lens has the same smooth curve as the second.
The first sky lens isn't as smooth as the second.
explanation_ru: По условию изгиб линз абсолютно одинаковый, что точно передаёт конструкция the same ... as.

prompt: Tracey left an unhappy review of the harbour concert. The flute was very soft, while glasses clinking at the bar sounded much louder all evening.
options: The flute sounded twice as loud as the clinking glasses at the bar.
The bar noise was completely similar to the quiet flute music.
The quiet flute didn't sound nearly as loud as the clinking glasses by the door.
The clinking glasses at the bar were just as soft as the flute.
explanation_ru: Звук флейты сильно уступал шуму бокалов, поэтому верно только отрицательное сравнение didn't sound nearly as loud as.

prompt: Salvo says the morning trams are more reliable than the lunchtime ones. → Salvo says the lunchtime trams aren't …
answer: Salvo says the lunchtime trams aren't as reliable as the morning ones.
accepted_answers: Salvo says the lunchtime trams aren't as reliable as the morning ones.
Salvo says the lunchtime trams are not as reliable as the morning ones.
Salvo says the lunchtime trams aren't so reliable as the morning ones.
Salvo says the lunchtime trams are not so reliable as the morning ones.
Salvo says the lunchtime trams aren't as reliable as the morning trams.
Salvo says the lunchtime trams are not as reliable as the morning trams.
explanation_ru: Чтобы сохранить смысл при смене порядка предметов, заменяем more reliable than на отрицательную конструкцию aren't as/so reliable as.
